description: Source code for the BarChartRenderer class in the PDFsharp library, responsible for rendering bar charts in PDF documents. Contains methods for initialization, layout, and drawing of bar charts, including handling of series, axes, legend, and plot area.

classes.name: BarChartRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders bar charts within the PDFsharp charting framework, handling layout, initialization, and drawing of bar chart components.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific information including axes, legend, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space allocation for the chart components.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the entire bar chart, including legend, axes, plot area, gridlines, data labels, and series.

methods.name: GetPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific plot area renderer based on chart type.

methods.name: GetLegendRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific legend renderer based on chart type.

methods.name: GetYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific Y axis renderer based on chart type.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes data structures for rendering all series in the chart.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Initializes visual formats and point renderers for each series.
